newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving up on return of investors.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving up on return of investors.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may rise slightly on Monday as investors return after the end of the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival, brokers said.
"Both volume and price are expected to pick up as investors are gradually returning after the Eid. The prices are attractive and most shares may gain," said broker Khurshid Alam.
Brokers said pharmaceutical and leather scrips might rise.
The DSE benchmark index closed 7.25 points or 0.65 percent up at 1,121.15 on a turnover of 14 million taka on Sunday. A three-day Eid holiday ended on Saturday.
